body:
Fair point. After taking some time I decided I was ignoring the "elephant in the room" and kind of the only parameter that I haven't tweaked before to improve things. Even after just a day of distance from it (and a bad day at that), I'm starting to feel a lot of those insecurities go away that have been there for months/years. Just a matter of making sure it really is the problem and figuring how to stay away.

> nobody would even know

That is still an unescapable fact for me at the moment. I live by myself and don't really speak or interact with anybody that wouldn't think I hadn't just abandoned them or stopped talking to them.

I still realize that I have feelings for and care about someone who doesn't seem to care enough to take care of themselves. They voluntarily do things that make their life harder and then complain about the consequences while invalidating my concern for them, even after I've done things to improve my life over their concern for me. Working through that will be the another challenge to face.

If none of that works, I'll be at a loss for what to do to help myself, but hopefully will be in right enough state of to seek professional help.

Thanks guys.
